Panchayati Raj represents decentralization of democratic power, Community development, and participation of people. 48. Which one of the following is not the characteristic of decentralization? (a) Autonomy (b) People's participation (c) To instil non-conﬁ dence among local communities (d) To empower local communities (e) None of the above/More than one of the above. 66th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2020 Ans. (c) Decentralization means delegation of authority to make decisions to the lowest possible organisational hierarchy level. Under decentralization, an organization's central unit distributes functions, responsibility, accountability to regional and local units. Thus, decentralization marks an extension of the process of delegation. Thus, autonomy of regional or local units, People's Participation and to empower local communities is the characteristics of the decentralization, while to install non-conﬁ dence among local communities is not the characteristics of decentralization. 49.
